correctness.rationale: For odd p≥5, Z_p^×=μ_(p−1)×(1+p Z_p), so x↦x^p maps Haar-uniform units to the p−1 Teichmüller cosets H_p+p²Z_p with density p on their union. The nonunit input event has probability p^-1 and maps by multiplication p^p. Convolve the one-input distribution: μ=g_p(t mod p²)dt+p^-2(S_p)_*μ, where g_p=m_p+2·1_H and ∫g=1−p^-2, yielding an absolutely continuous density by summable residual mass. At level n≤p the singular contribution is a delta at zero with normalized weight p^{n−2}; at n≥p it is p^{p−2}F_{n−p} on p^p-multiples. Square and average: G_p+2(p−1)/p²+p^{n−4} for 2≤n≤p, and G_p+2(p−1)/p²+p^{p−4} M_{n−p} otherwise. Since p^{p−4}>1, M diverges at rate p^{(p−4)n/p}. On shells v_p(t)=pk+r, F(t) is O(p^{k(p−2)}), while disjoint sets E_k=p^{pk}(H_p+p²Z_p) have mass (p−1)p^{−pk−2} and F(t)≥2p^{k(p−2)}; therefore L^s iff s<p/(p−2). F_{p,n} are conditional expectations and converge in these Ls spaces. Independent exact modular convolution checked H_5={1,7,18,24}, 13 supported residue classes, Σg_5²=52, and finite p=5,7 small-level fibres/moments. These finite observations corroborate, not replace, the measure proof.
